Problem removed** — what pain goes away" ("so Postgres migrations stop being hand-written guesses"). The third slot is not a third axis at all — it is labeled "**3. Recommended** — answers both audiences without splitting the line," i.e. a selection verdict/synthesis, not a distinct framing.
